title: HyFlash: A Prefix-Memory Prior for On-Device Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.07263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel block drafting accelerates speculative decoding by predicting multiple future positions in a single backbone pass, but on-device deployment constrains both drafter capacity and context storage. Under tight memory budgets, drafters must model long-range dependencies and fine-grained draft-position interactions without the growing KV-cache overhead of full-context attention. We propose HyFlash, a compact parallel drafter that introduces a prefix-memory prior to separate long-range context modeling from fine-grained draft-position interactions with limited capacity. Local attention captures recent context and draft-position interactions, while recurrent memory compresses historical target features into fixed-size states. This inductive bias enables effective local and long-range modeling with bounded draft-side memory. translated_title: HyFlash：一种用于端侧投机解码的前缀记忆先验
translated_abstract: 并行块草拟通过在单次骨干网络前向传播中预测多个未来位置来加速投机解码，但端侧部署同时限制了草拟器的能力和上下文存储。在紧张的内存预算下，草拟器必须在不会产生全上下文注意力那种不断增长的KV缓存开销的情况下，建模长程依赖和细粒度的草拟位置交互。我们提出HyFlash，一种紧凑的并行草拟器，它引入前缀记忆先验，在能力有限的情况下将长程上下文建模与细粒度的草拟位置交互分离开来。局部注意力负责捕获近期上下文和草拟位置交互，而循环记忆则将历史目标特征压缩为固定大小的状态。这种归纳偏置使得在草拟侧内存有限的情况下，仍能进行有效的局部和长程建模。实验表明，HyFlash以显著更少的KV存储实现了比全上下文注意力更高的接受率。
tldr: HyFlash提出一种引入前缀记忆先验的紧凑并行草拟器，将长程上下文建模与细粒度草拟位置交互分离，以显著更少的内存实现了比全上下文注意力更高的投机解码接受率。
